description: Decision-readiness register: questions answered by verified data, and open questions/information gaps that must be closed before any decision is reasonably made. Each open question includes a discovery suggestion. Nothing is inferred to fill gaps.

answered.question: What is every team's record and scoring margin through Week 9 + TNF?
answered.answer: Full 32-team table captured and reconciled (home+away sums match, diff = PF-PA verified).

answered.question: What games remain in Week 10 and what does Week 11 look like?
answered.answer: 13 remaining Week-10 games (14 incl. played TNF) + 13 Week-11 games + 6 byes, all with official links.

answered.question: Who is ruled out / doubtful / questionable for Week 10?
answered.answer: All 32 teams' game-day designations captured (~165 rows) + line-moving IR subset (~65 rows).

answered.question: What are the current market spreads/totals/MLs for Weeks 10-11?
answered.answer: DraftKings lines via ESPN captured for all 13 Week-10 and 13 Week-11 games + Super Bowl futures.

answered.question: Which teams are fielding 2nd/3rd/4th stringers at key spots?
answered.answer: Rule-based deficiency table (24 rows) + chart-verified string claims for PIT and BAL only.

open.question: What bankroll, unit size, and reward structure should the competition use?
open.discovery_suggestion: Owner questionnaire (SUG-08); until answered, leaderboard runs points-only (LB default).

open.question: Risk tolerance: max drawdown, stop-loss, Kelly fraction?
Where is a timestamped historical odds + results archive for backtesting?
open.blocks: G-3 walk-forward validation of every strategy
open.discovery_suggestion: SUG-04: license an odds archive vendor or scrape-and-store forward from now (tracking already started 2026-11-14).

open.question: Which sportsbook(s) define 'the line' for CLV and comparison?
open.discovery_suggestion: Owner decision; currently only DraftKings (via ESPN) is captured (Q-04 open).

open.question: How are strategy submissions made (code, pick sheet, form) and who timestamps them?
open.discovery_suggestion: SUG-05 recommendation: git-committed pick files (commit time = timestamp).

open.question: What is a verified source for player prop lines?
open.discovery_suggestion: SUG-07: evaluate licensed prop data vendors; until verified, prop strategies stay blocked (no hallucinated lines).

open.question: Play-by-play feed for measuring same-game leg correlations?
open.discovery_suggestion: SUG-07: ingest game books (NFL.com official game pages) or licensed PBP; pilot n=16 correlations published as reference only.

open.question: Snap-count source to confirm exactly which string each player is?
open.discovery_suggestion: SUG-06: pull official gamebooks weekly (they list participation).

open.question: What HFA applies to neutral-site games (Munich, Mexico City)?
open.blocks: S5, model lines for international games
open.discovery_suggestion: Backtest international series results from official game pages (SUG-09).

open.question: Weather data source for totals adjustments?
Can official team depth charts (all 32) be pulled weekly?
open.discovery_suggestion: SUG-06: automate per-team depth pulls from team official sites.

open.question: Is the source whitelist (NFL.com official; ESPN trusted; DraftKings via ESPN market) approved?
Are real-money rewards / wagering permitted in the owner's jurisdiction (owner located in Japan)?
open.discovery_suggestion: SUG-05: legal review before any funded activity; competition defaults to points-only.

open.question: Who reviews the Suggestions page and how often are statuses updated?
open.discovery_suggestion: Owner sets cadence; proposed weekly review (SUG-11).

open.question: Should injury/odds/standings snapshots be automated (GitHub Actions 3x/week)?
open.blocks: nothing now (manual snapshots work, but stale fast)
open.discovery_suggestion: SUG-03: scheduled workflow; keeps CLV timestamps continuous.
